All six public groups pass and static review supports the remaining implementation requirements. Clarity/validation -0.5: the proposed test at cache-line offset 31 with length 1 is invalid because the pointer is not four-byte aligned. Even without the alignment rule, that interval ends exactly at the next line boundary and would span 32 bytes, not the claimed 64. This explanation defect does not change the correct implementation.

Compilation fails under the declared warning-as-error flags because the comment contains the nested comment opener in "*base/*span"; functional correctness is zero (-2). No candidate repair was made. Static review supports the remaining resource, timing, ownership, recovery, and portability dimensions on the specified target/host widths. Independently, clarity/validation -0.5: the proposed 0xFFFFFFE0/96-byte test is described as a round-up overflow rejection, but it is valid on the 64-bit host; on the 32-bit target the buffer end itself overflows. The comment compilation defect is not deducted again elsewhere.
